description: List recent US federal civil lawsuits, newest first, optionally limited to one district. No API key. A case removed from state court carries a removed_from object naming the originating state court and its state docket number.

check_removal.description: Look up which state court each case was removed from (default true). Set false to skip one upstream request per call when you do not need it.

filed_after.description: Only cases filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: federal_civil_recent
